rationale: Major ATM OEM corporate site + newsroom, confirmed in the SI installed base; standalone recurring signal source.
Core competitor OEM site with newsroom and locations directory establishing SI coverage model; monitor the root domain and re-derive the directory path.
Austrian recycler OEM with a maintained references page and banking news feed; likeliest place a Slovenian/parent-group win appears.
Leading independent multivendor ATM/branch software competitor; vendor + partner-ecosystem pages produce ongoing deal signals.
Cash-automation OEM with an evidenced Slovenian distributor channel; distributor/news pages keep producing branch-automation signal.
Local integrator with a dedicated bank-equipment line; low-credibility but a genuine adjacent-competitor catalogue worth periodic diffing.
Incumbent country site used as the like-for-like benchmark baseline for competitor country pages.
Central-bank statistics hub is the authoritative ATM/POS denominator and a de facto operator register; legally allowed and continuously updated.
Ministry portal carrying the cash-access bill consultation — the strongest forward demand driver; keep as a monitored publisher, not a one-off draft.
Official company register plus eObjave filings; queryable repeatedly for entity presence and competitor financials.
Bank ATM locators with deposit-capability flags; time-diffing them is the best public proxy for recycler rollouts.
Single branch-renovation microsite — valuable case evidence, but a one-off page rather than a producing feed.
Trade press plus association showroom directory; both a continuous news feed and a snowball route to the wider vendor set.
National business news section that dates ATM-fleet and cash-access events; watch for paywalls on individual outlets.
Community forum with weak credibility but useful ground-truth leads on machine makes and deposit rollouts; treat as lead generator only.
Vendor news index carrying named core-banking migration case studies — recurring deal-level evidence banks never publish.
Leading domestic banking/payments software vendor corporate site; base layer for product and positioning tracking.
High-value installed-base FAQ but a sub-page of halcom.com already monitored; capture via the parent domain crawl.
Domestic e-document/e-invoice network vendor connected to banks and UJP — a payments adjacency squarely in scope under sector=both.
Single ERP help article confirming the ZZI–bank e-invoice path; corroborating evidence, not an ongoing signal source.
Major SI integrator with an explicit banking/finance vertical; solution pages reveal localised foreign platforms.
Registry-aggregator record used once to fix Comtrade's SI entity names and codes, then archived in favour of the group site.
Procurement aggregator with per-supplier and per-buyer pages incl. Banka Slovenije — the best route to named contracts, values and dates.
Facilities/access-control supplier with a real bank-side tender footprint; in scope but peripheral to the A6 core, so low cadence.
Domestic DMS/e-archive vendor whose news pages surface bank deployments; a genuine competitor-map actor site.
Public references page converting directly into named vendor-bank relationships, bilingual and maintained.
Registry record used once to pin the entity for procurement tracking; the vendor's own site is the follow-on monitored target.
